item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] NCPI unchanged at 8.1% in Sept.
item.description: National inflation held steady at 8.1% year-on-year (YoY) in September 2026, unchanged from August, as higher food prices offset a decline in non-food costs, according to the latest National Consumer Price Index (NCPI) data released by the Department of Census and Statistics (DCS) yesterday.
